title: Winspace T1600 Review: This Aero Bike Has Been My Race Weapon for Seven Months

takeaways.text: Self-bought race and training bike: about 6,000 km over seven months of duathlons and time trials in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with no faults, headset issues or loosening parts.

He rides a size labelled 54 (normally a 56) with a longer stem; the XL is labelled 540 but has a long 575 mm effective top tube because of the sloping top tube, so check reach rather than the size label.

The build needed no sanding or grinding; the one-piece cockpit makes brake-hose routing the trickiest step. Fully internal routing is electronic-only, with a Di2 battery door under the 86.5 mm T47 shell.

Aero gains come mostly from the Hyper bar, which he strongly recommends buying with the frame; the frame is sensitive to wheel and tire choice, and he advises 50 mm+ deep wheels with 28–30 mm tires rather than very wide setups.
Buying from Winspace's global site, he says, ships from regional stock without extra taxes and gives local warranty service in the UK, US and much of Europe.

disclosure: The description links the creator's supplier discount codes and paid Patreon material. Frame-supply terms are not established by the public description.
summary: Long-term T1600 review based on the creator's race build. The original T1600 is kept separate from T1600 Ultra; aero and stiffness discussion is contextual, not an accepted catalog ranking.
